Law 01 · glass Night pane
  • Glass has no contrast of its own. Veil on sky is 1.31:1, so the rim separates a pane — never the fill.
  • A pane is an edge, not a shape. Every division inside it is a 1px mullion, never a gap.
  • Two masses, one street. Never equal heights, never a third tower, never a stroke.
  • One red, off the bus. #B01B26 fills and marks; at night the signal is the glow, because 2.76:1 cannot carry type.
